source.note: How outside classifications reach data/taxonomy.json. types: each Wikidata type in directory.json that was reviewed, as [English label, node, relation or status, why]. Relation says how the type relates to the node: equivalent, narrower or overlapping (some of its products may belong elsewhere). Status generic: the type names a licence, delivery or platform, not a job, so its products stay unplaced. Status excluded: not a software product. A type that is not listed takes the nearest listed type above it (walking up Wikidata's subclass links, stopping at generic and excluded types); if the nearest ones disagree, its products stay unplaced as ambiguous. catalog and lanes map AirStack's own categories; products places catalog and registry products one by one where a category holds more than one kind of software.
